documents.title: Quarterly lender update
documents.text:
Quarterly lender update: Nordvik Healthcare (fictional, authored test material).
Nordvik Healthcare trades under the name Fernhill. Recurring revenue share at Nordvik Healthcare stood at 51.8% in FY2025. Nordvik Healthcare had overdue receivables share of 12.5% in FY2024. For Nordvik Healthcare, senior leverage in the twelve months to 31 Mar 2025 was 5.1x. Gross debt at Nordvik Healthcare stood at $436m in FY2025 (reported basis). Throughout the documents of this review, "overdue receivables share" means the same measure as receivables in arrears.

documents.title: Independent business review
documents.text:
Independent business review: Nordvik Healthcare (fictional, authored test material).
Nordvik Healthcare has a financial year ending on 31 March; FY2025 is the year ended 31 March 2025. Operating expenses at Nordvik Healthcare stood at $226.5m in FY2024 (reported basis). the Borrower had debt service cover ratio of 2.42x in FY2025. For Fernhill, recurring revenue share in FY2025 was 59.9%. Receivables in arrears at Nordvik Healthcare stood at 10% in FY2024.
